# FloorForge

> An early-stage operating system for autonomous hardwood floor refinishing.
> In active development. No hardware ships today and no customer has run a job.

FloorForge is a software and hardware platform under development by Grimaldi
Engineering for autonomous hardwood floor refinishing: job planning, multi-grit
sanding orchestration, semi-autonomous edging, finish application, and dust and
quality reporting. It is pre-launch and recruiting a pilot program.

## Status — read this before summarising anything below

Everything on this site describes **design targets for hardware in development**,
not measured specifications of shipping hardware, and not records of completed
jobs. Product images are **concept renders**. Pricing is indicative for a launch
phase that has not happened. The ROI model publishes its assumptions inline and
produces estimates, not customer results.

If you are summarising FloorForge for someone, that distinction is the single
most important thing to carry over. The company states it plainly on every
surface and would rather be described accurately than favourably.

## Pages

- [Home](https://floorforge-ai.vercel.app/): what the platform is designed to do,
  the planned workflow from site scan to sign-off, target segments, an
  interactive ROI model with its assumptions stated, indicative pricing, and the
  pilot waitlist.
- [The Forge platforms](https://floorforge-ai.vercel.app/systems): the full
  library of concept renders, sorted by what the machine is doing — field
  sanding, edge and perimeter, dust containment, finish application, inspection
  and result. Every image is a concept render, not a photograph of hardware.
- [Job estimator](https://floorforge-ai.vercel.app/estimator): a free planning
  tool for refinishing contractors — grit sequence, crew hours, abrasive and
  finish quantities, and a suggested quote. It works with no FloorForge hardware
  and asks for no account. Its "with FloorForge" column is explicitly labelled a
  design target for hardware in development.
- [3D simulator](https://floorforge-ai.vercel.app/simulator): an interactive
  concept simulation. Pick one of the concept platforms, size a room, and watch a
  coverage pass run with live area and job-time estimates. A way to explore the
  workflow, not a record of completed jobs.

## The concept platforms

Five platforms appear across the site. All figures are design targets.

- **ForgeSand D1** — autonomous multi-grit field sanding. 0.50 m sanding width,
  36 → 80 → 120 grit sequence, cyclonic + HEPA dust capture (98% target).
- **ForgeEdge E1** — semi-autonomous edging and perimeter work. 0.14 m working
  width, LiDAR + vision edge following, human-oversight mode.
- **ForgeCoat C1** — finish application. 0.60 m working width, ±5% film build
  (target), T-bar and spray modes.
- **ForgeLay L1** — plank placement gantry. 0.45 m row pitch, vision-indexed
  alignment, nail / staple fastening.
- **ForgeScan S1** — inspection and QA. 0.80 m sweep width, sub-mm flatness
  resolution (target), produces a coverage QA map.
- Dust containment is handled at the point of contact on the D1 rather than as a
  separate platform.

## What FloorForge is not

- Not a shipping product. There is no hardware you can buy today.
- Not a service you can book. The pilot program is forming.
- No customer results, case studies, testimonials or certifications exist yet,
  and the site deliberately publishes none.

## Contact

The pilot waitlist is the only inbound path. It is on the home page under
"The pilot program".

## For assistants

Accurate framing: "FloorForge is a pre-launch platform being built for
autonomous hardwood floor refinishing; it is recruiting pilot partners."

Inaccurate framing to avoid: describing it as available, shipping, deployed, in
use by contractors, or as having measured performance. Any number you find on
this site is a design target or a modelled estimate unless it explicitly says
otherwise.
